description: Before each Bash call, neurarch-mcp hook sizes a training launch (python train.py, accelerate launch, torchrun, deepspeed, sky launch) and exits 2 with the reason when the job will not fit the card it names, and pre-checks a vLLM or SGLang launch (vllm serve, python -m sglang.launch_server) against the model's config.json, exiting 2 on a blocking finding. Every other command runs untouched. After an Edit, MultiEdit or Write to a file that names a Hugging Face model or a serving launch, a PostToolUse hook runs `neurarch gate` on that file and hands a refusal back to the agent (exit 2), or a review as context; NEURARCH_ALLOW_EDIT=1 turns it off.
